snippet.title: TOTAL WAR: WARHAMMER 40,000 – INCOMING BROADCAST | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
AUDIO LOG RECEIVED – ARMAGEDDON SECTOR UNDER XENOS INCURSION. THREAT LEVEL: TOTAL. WAR IS UPON US.
// 17 CYCLES TO NEXT TRANSMISSION //

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

Revealed at WARHAMMER SKULLS – a critical sector of the Imperium and some familiar faces. Journey with us to our next reveal of information and gameplay for Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
